es: Resolver una situación real —acoger a una estudiante de intercambio— combinando deducción, anécdota precisa, negociación con condición y una queja transmitida con tacto.

teaching.en: You must be tired after such a long journey.
teaching.es: Debes de estar cansada después de un viaje tan largo.
teaching.explanationEs: Must be + adjetivo deduce cómo está alguien ahora: es una forma amable de dar la bienvenida.
teaching.audioText: You must be tired after such a long journey.

teaching.en: When I arrived in Dublin, I had forgotten my charger, so my phone died.
teaching.es: Cuando llegué a Dublín, me había olvidado el cargador, así que mi móvil se apagó.
teaching.explanationEs: Pasado simple para los hechos y had + participio para lo que ocurrió antes: así la anécdota es precisa.

forgotten my charger, so my phone died.

teaching.en: You can use the kitchen as long as you clean up afterwards.
teaching.es: Puedes usar la cocina siempre que limpies después.
teaching.explanationEs: As long as introduce una condición; después no se usa will.
segments: You can use the kitchen as
long as you clean up afterwards.
teaching.audioText: You can use the kitchen as long as you clean up afterwards.

teaching.en: I'd appreciate it if you could keep the noise down after ten.
teaching.es: Te agradecería que pudieras hacer poco ruido después de las diez.
teaching.explanationEs: I'd appreciate it if you could… pide algo sin acusar; no olvides it.

teaching.explanationEs: Is/are said to have + participio transmite una queja sin señalar a nadie.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo recibes a tu invitada, que llega agotada del vuelo?

choices.text: You should be tired after the flight.
You used to be tired after the flight.
You must be tired after the flight.

feedback.es: Must be + adjetivo deduce cómo está alguien ahora a partir de lo que sabes; should y used to no expresan esa deducción.

hint.es: Es una deducción sobre cómo está ahora: ¿qué modal la expresa?

origin.text: Tu estudiante de intercambio acaba de llegar tras doce horas de vuelo. Piensas que seguro está cansada.

prompt.es: Completa: «Puedes usar mi bici siempre que la devuelvas.»

feedback.es: As long as introduce una condición: «siempre que».

hint.es: Piensa en la expresión inglesa para «siempre que»: falta su primera palabra.

origin.text: You can use my bike ___ long as you bring it back.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Te agradecería que bajaras la música después de las diez.»

answer.text: I'd appreciate it if you could turn the music down after ten
accepted: I'd appreciate it if you could turn the music down after ten
I'd appreciate it if you could turn down the music after ten

feedback.es: I'd appreciate it if you could… es una petición con tacto y lleva it.

hint.es: Es una petición con tacto; la hora va al final.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con su función en la visita.

pairs: You must be hungry after the trip.
I had lost my key, so I waited outside.
You can stay up late provided that you are quiet.
The neighbours are said to have called the police.

feedback.es: Cada frase tiene una función: acoger con una deducción, contar una anécdota, negociar una condición o transmitir una queja sin acusar.

pairs: You must be hungry after the trip.
I had lost my key, so I waited outside.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase plantea una queja con tacto?

choices.text: I'd appreciate it if you could wash your plates after dinner.
Wash your plates now or I will be angry.
You never wash your plates and it is terrible.

feedback.es: I'd appreciate it if you could… pide un cambio sin acusar; las otras frases son una amenaza y un reproche.

origin.text: Tu estudiante deja los platos sucios cada noche. Quieres pedirle que los lave sin ofenderle.

prompt.es: Escribe la condición para usar el ordenador.

answer.text: You can use my computer as long as you turn it off afterwards.
accepted: You can use my computer as long as you turn it off afterwards.
You can use my computer provided that you turn it off afterwards.
You can use my computer if you turn it off afterwards.

feedback.es: La condición se expresa con as long as o provided that más el presente, sin will.

origin.text: Dejas usar tu ordenador a tu invitada, pero solo si lo apaga al terminar.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué le reprocha Carlos a Mia.

choices.text: She did not clean the kitchen.
She went to bed too early.

feedback.es: Should have + participio critica lo que no se hizo: Mia no limpió la cocina.

origin.audio: Mia, the kitchen is a mess. You should have cleaned up after dinner, but I know you were tired.

prompt.es: ¿Qué mensaje cuenta bien lo que dijiste a los vecinos?

choices.text: I said them that we had a guest.
I told to them that we had a guest.
I told them that we had a guest.

feedback.es: Told necesita su complemento (them) y sin to: I told them. Las otras formas son incorrectas.

origin.text: Ayer avisaste a los vecinos: «Tenemos una invitada». Ahora se lo cuentas a Mia.

prompt.es: Completa: «Estoy de acuerdo con la norma de la casa.»

feedback.es: Agree es un verbo y no lleva be: I agree.

prompt.es: Escribe tu mensaje de acogida (70–130 palabras) con los cuatro datos.

answer.text: Welcome, Mia! You must be tired after such a long journey. When I arrived in Dublin, I had forgotten my charger, so my phone died and I got lost. Now about the rules: you can use the kitchen as long as you clean up afterwards. Also, the neighbours are said to have complained about the noise last week, so I'd appreciate it if you could keep the music down after ten. I hope you will be happy here!
accepted: Welcome, Mia! You must be tired after such a long journey. When I arrived in Dublin, I had forgotten my charger, so my phone died and I got lost. Now about the rules: you can use the kitchen as long as you clean up afterwards. Also, the neighbours are said to have complained about the noise last week, so I'd appreciate it if you could keep the music down after ten. I hope you will be happy here!

Hello, Mia, and welcome! You must be exhausted after the long journey. When I arrived in Dublin, I had forgotten my charger, so my phone died. Here is one rule: you can use the kitchen provided that you clean up afterwards. The neighbours are said to have complained about the noise, so I would appreciate it if you could keep it down after ten.

Welcome, Mia! You must be tired after such a long journey. When I arrived in Dublin, I had forgotten my charger, so my phone died and I got lost. Now about the rules: you can use the kitchen as long as you clean up afterwards. Also, the neighbors are said to have complained about the noise last week, so I'd appreciate it if you could keep the music down after ten. I hope you will be happy here!

feedback.es: El mensaje combina acoger, una anécdota con had, una norma con as long as y una queja con tacto.

origin.text: Recibes a Mia, estudiante de intercambio. 1) Dale la bienvenida y deduce que está cansada. 2) Cuenta tu primer viaje: habías olvidado el cargador y el móvil se apagó. 3) Negocia una norma: puede usar la cocina si limpia después. 4) Transmite con tacto una queja: los vecinos se quejaron del ruido.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué era nuevo para la estudiante.

choices.text: It was the first time she saw snow.
It was the first time she travelled alone.
It was the first time she visited Rome.

feedback.es: Had never seen snow indica que era la primera vez que veía nieve.

origin.audio: She had never seen snow before she came to my house. On the first morning, we played outside together.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Puedes quedarte despierta hasta tarde siempre que estés tranquila.»

answer.text: You can stay up late as long as you are quiet
accepted: You can stay up late as long as you are quiet
As long as you are quiet you can stay up late

feedback.es: As long as + presente expresa la condición de la norma.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cuenta la anécdota con el orden del pasado claro?

choices.text: When I got to the airport, I had realised I leave my passport at home.
When I got to the airport, I realised I had left my passport at home.
When I had got to the airport, I realised I leave my passport at home.

feedback.es: Had left marca lo anterior (dejar el pasaporte) y got y realised cuentan los hechos en orden.

origin.text: Llegaste al aeropuerto y entonces descubriste que antes habías dejado el pasaporte en casa.
